critical_code_review_comments: Minor: edr-context-error surfaces the code INCIDENT_NOT_FOUND in innerText but does not expose it as a `data-error-code` attribute; a DOM-attribute mirror would be cleaner for automation than string parsing.

Minor observation: on default 24h load the Activity pane rendered 0 amp-activity-row-* items in this session (because the hatched no-sensor region dominates the window), so the amp-filter-search count-change assertion could not be exercised end-to-end. Element itself is present and accepts input; a shorter window or auto-fit-on-load would make this trivially testable, but owner explicitly rejected 'Fit to observations' so this is acceptable.
Enhancement (still open from iter_101): add data-glyph on amp-event-* <g> for semantic type, so tests don't have to peek at DOM shape.
context_for_next_testing_agent: P0-F.13.3 PASS. The structural nesting of all 11 EDR routes inside XdrShell is stable (single topbar per route, zero console errors, non-empty nvf-main). AMP header baseline (title + theme + legacy link + fullscreen) confirmed; forbidden legacy header controls (breadcrumbs, presets, fit, refresh, export) are absent. Customer menu is single-column. XDR pivot banner supports all three server-validated states: REFERENCES_THIS_ENDPOINT (inc_2305c71cd8f54dc38e55), INCIDENT_NOT_FOUND (bogus id), ENDPOINT_NOT_REFERENCED_BY_INCIDENT (inc_3cf06d55a75a4963a3c6). Backend /api/edr/context ignores query-string tenant. session-context matches mss/customer-operations counts (default=241). Theme is unified via localStorage 'nx.theme' + 'nx-theme' event, both toggles are one truth and persist over reload.
